idea-plugin.name: Agent CLI
idea-plugin.description:
Run AI coding agents directly inside your JetBrains IDE with a fully embedded terminal and session management, either in the tool window or in regular editor tabs.

  • Support for Claude Code, Cursor Agent and OpenAI Codex — start a session for any enabled agent from the + menu.
  • Multiple simultaneous sessions — create, switch, close, and delete sessions. Sessions auto-close when the agent process exits.
  • Session history — browse past sessions grouped by date (Today, Yesterday, This Week, Older) and resume previous sessions by ID where local agent data is available.
  • Editor-hosted sessions — right-click any active or historical session and pick "Open in Code Editor" to move it into a regular editor tab; a "Return to plugin view" link moves it back. Optional settings let new sessions and/or resumed historical sessions always open as editor tabs by default.
  • Attention notifications — when an agent needs your input (permission prompts, idle confirmations, Codex permission requests), the session row shows a red dot instead of the green play icon and an IDE balloon (with OS banner) fires. Opt-in: install hooks from Settings with a one-click action that merges idempotently into Claude / Codex config files, with .bak backups and clean uninstall.
  • High-performance embedded terminal — xterm.js-based with optional watermark flow control, clickable URL detection, UTF-8 encoding, and a 10,000-line scrollback buffer.
  • Theme-aware UI — terminal colors and scrollbars follow the IDE look-and-feel and update dynamically when the theme changes.
  • Compact session sidebar — collapsible panel showing active sessions and browsable history with right-click context menus. A red overlay dot on the collapse toggle keeps attention-needed state visible when the sidebar is collapsed.
  • Per-agent configuration (Settings → Tools → Agent CLI) — enable or disable each agent, customize launch commands, adjust terminal font size, toggle flow control, and choose where new or resumed sessions open.

Note: A JetBrains Runtime with JCEF is required for the embedded terminal. Install and sign in to each agent CLI you use separately.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Fixed a crash (NoClassDefFoundError: JBCefApp) when opening the tool window on IntelliJ Platform 2026.2+ — the plugin now declares the JCEF platform module dependency.
  • Fixed historical session resolution for projects whose path contains a "." (or other non-alphanumeric characters) in a directory name.
  • Removed the Gemini CLI agent type following Google's discontinuation of the CLI.

0.9.1

  • Added project-scoped settings (Settings → Tools → Agent CLI → Project), stored in the project's workspace file.
  • Added a "Project args" field for the Sandbox agent — extra arguments substituted into the sandbox command's {project_args} placeholder for that project only (appended if the placeholder is absent).

0.9.0

  • Added a new "Sandbox" agent type that runs any underlying agent CLI through a generic wrapper command (e.g. a containerized, sandboxed runner) — configure the wrapper command (with a {dir} placeholder for the project path), a history directory, and which agent runs inside the sandbox.
  • Sandbox sessions are visually distinguished by a green gradient bar across the top of the terminal and a matching gradient label in the history list.

Full changelogs can be found at https://github.com/sajithdilshan/agent-cli-plugin/tree/main/changelog
